"وان خاک کنم ز دیده تر گر خواهی" = I will bury myself in the earth from my tearful eyes if you wish. "بر خاک نهم پیش تو سر گر خواهی" = I will put my head on the earth before you if you wish. So theme: devotion, self-sacrifice, burying self, offering head.

"بر سرو دیده نهم رأی تو را" = I will put my head on the cedar tree? "رای تو را" maybe "your opinion"? Hard. "گر بود ای شوخ چشم رای تو بر خون من" = If you were, oh witty eye, your judgement on my blood. Hard.

"مقبل کسی که در سر کوی تو می رود" = I approach someone who goes to your neighborhood. "ز آن آمدم که بر سر کوی تو سر نهم" = I came that I will put my head on your neighborhood? So again head on.

Option 3: "I will put my head on the cedar tree; if it were, oh witty eye, your judgement on my blood." This seems to involve a cedar tree and maybe a metaphor of seeking judgment, not about devotion to a person.
